phenomenon: Daily aggregate sentiment and thirty-day engagement in marijuana-related Twitter content
research_problem: It is not yet known whether NORC GSMA VADER sentiment measures are associated with thirty-day engagement after accounting for time and account category.

population_context.value: English-language marijuana-related Twitter records represented in GSMA PowerTrack All Daily

constructs.name: aggregate sentiment
constructs.working_definition: Daily VADER compound or positive-to-negative score aggregated within a GSMA account category.

constructs.name: thirty-day engagement
constructs.working_definition: Retweets, replies, and quotes received within thirty days of the original tweet, aggregated by day and category.

research_questions: How are GSMA daily aggregate sentiment measures associated with thirty-day engagement across account categories?

provisional_contribution.statement: Provide a bounded descriptive and associational account of sentiment and engagement in the archived GSMA series.

assumptions: The official variable definitions and archive release remain applicable to the cached files.
uncertainties: The selected literature is a tracer bullet rather than exhaustive coverage.
The usable distribution of engagement variables has not yet been analysed.
user_decisions: Keep the pilot small and use an associational claim boundary.

claims.statement: The unit of inference is an account-category-day aggregate, not an individual.
